required_public_surface.name: descriptor_for_candidate
required_public_surface.contract: Return a deterministic integer descriptor tuple from a candidate and metric bundle.

required_public_surface.name: score_candidate
required_public_surface.contract: Return bounded fitness, components, and evidence required for audit.

required_public_surface.name: insert_candidate
required_public_surface.signature: insert_candidate(archive: dict, candidate: dict, score: dict, descriptor: tuple[int, ...]) -> dict
required_public_surface.contract: Insert or replace an elite deterministically according to niche and fitness.

required_public_surface.name: build_archive
required_public_surface.contract: Build an archive from candidates and precomputed metrics without using scalar top-k as the archive.

required_public_surface.name: archive_summary
required_public_surface.contract: Return coverage, QD score, best fitness, mean elite fitness, and calibration status.

candidate_acceptance: Candidate contains grid, descriptor, fitness, fitness_components, validation, and provenance.
Candidate grid passes mecha_engine.genome.validate_grid before insertion.
Invalid candidates may be reported but must not become elites.
Candidate metric bundle includes readability, lifecycle, SLIP alignment, mutation stability, and provenance where available.
descriptor_acceptance: Support baseline body_mass, sensor_count, and symmetry descriptor dimensions.
Support extended body_mass, sensor_count, symmetry, readability, lifecycle_survival, mutation_stability, and behavior_neediness dimensions.
Expose descriptor names and cardinalities in archive metadata.
Reject or explicitly mark missing metric inputs.
Distinguish observed occupied niches from theoretical total coverage.
Keep manual readability calibration status visible.
Do not lock final descriptor thresholds before manual readability ratings are collected.
fitness_acceptance: Include components, validation, readability, lifecycle, slip_alignment, and provenance.
Support survival, readability, validity, bond, mutation_stability, and SLIP alignment components.
insertion_acceptance: Insert candidate when niche is empty.
Replace existing elite only when new candidate has higher fitness.
Preserve previous archive when candidate does not win its niche.
Record enough information to audit insertion or replacement.
summary_acceptance: Report blocked or skipped candidate counts.
negative_checks: package tests mutate sys.path to reach labs
scalar top-k replaces MAP-Elites archive mechanics
theoretical coverage is compared directly across different descriptor dimensionalities without observed-niche context
proxy readability is presented as human-calibrated readability
final descriptor thresholds are locked before manual readability ratings are collected
